video_prompt: One continuous vertical front-camera phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. A young man with light-brown skin, short dark hair with a low fade and a short stubble beard, in a plain heather-grey sweatshirt, sits alone on a sofa in a dim living room at night and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. The phone is held steady at arm's length; the room behind him stays still and dim with a warm lamp glow. He talks straight into the camera in a confident, conspiratorial tone, like telling a friend a secret, with small natural head movements.
